asked: Given a customer selects a 'haircut', when they pick a time slot, the system reserves exactly 30 minutes of the barber's availability.
Given a customer selects a 'haircut and beard', when they pick a time slot, the system reserves exactly 45 minutes of the barber's availability.
Given a customer selects 'any barber', when they book a slot, the system assigns the appointment to the first available barber.
Given a customer selects a specific barber, when they book a slot, the system assigns the appointment only to that barber.
tests: tests/e2e/bookings.spec.ts › a customer books a free time on the public page without an account: provides name, email and phone, the booking is created and a confirmation email with a cancel link is sent
planCriteria.criterion: A customer books a free time on the public page without an account and the booking is created
Given a customer completes a booking, when the process finishes, the system sends a confirmation email containing a unique cancellation link.

asked: Given a customer clicks the cancellation link, when the current time is more than 6 hours before the appointment, the system successfully cancels the booking.
Given a customer clicks the cancellation link, when the current time is less than 6 hours before the appointment, the system prevents the cancellation.
tests: tests/e2e/bookings.spec.ts › a customer cancels the booking with the link of the confirmation email more than the notice hours before the start time; inside the notice period the link is refused
planCriteria.criterion: A customer cancels the booking with the link of the confirmation email before the notice hours; inside the notice period the link is refused
Given a barber views their calendar, when they access the dashboard, they see their specific daily and weekly schedule.

asked: Given a barber marks a time period as 'time off', when a customer attempts to book during that period, the system shows the slot as unavailable.
tests: tests/e2e/bookings.spec.ts › a staff member blocks time off to make those time slots unavailable for booking; customers are no longer offered them
planCriteria.criterion: A staff member blocks time off and those time slots are no longer offered for booking

asked: Given an appointment is being booked, when a slot is already occupied by another booking for a specific barber, the system prevents the double booking.
tests: tests/e2e/bookings.spec.ts › a customer cannot book a slot already taken: the same time is never booked twice for one team member (double booking prevented)
tests/unit/bookings.test.ts › locks every grid cell a booking covers (database-level double-booking guard)
